刘备.en: Liu Bei, a ruler he served

sents.zh: 汉朝以后，中国分成了三个国家。
sents.en: After the Han, China split into three states.

sents.zh: 这三个国常常打来打去。
sents.en: The three states fought one another constantly.

sents.zh: 那时候有一个很聪明的人，叫诸葛亮。
sents.en: There was a very clever man of that time called Zhuge Liang.

sents.zh: 他年轻的时候住在山里，天天看书。
sents.en: When he was young he lived in the hills and read every day.

sents.zh: 刘备去请了他三次，他才出来做事。
sents.en: Liu Bei went to ask him three times before he came out to serve.

sents.zh: 因为他知道的事情很多，所以大家都听他的。
sents.en: Because he knew so much, everyone listened to him.

sents.zh: 他会看天气，也会想办法。
sents.en: He could read the weather, and could find a way.

sents.zh: 有一次，敌人来了，可是城里的兵很少。
sents.en: Once the enemy came, but there were few soldiers in the city.

sents.zh: 诸葛亮没有关门，还一个人坐在城上面。
sents.en: Zhuge Liang did not close the gates, and sat alone up on the wall.

sents.zh: 敌人来了以后，看见门开着，觉得很奇怪。
sents.en: When the enemy arrived and saw the gates open, they thought it strange.

sents.zh: 他们以为城里一定有很多兵。
sents.en: They supposed the city must be full of soldiers.

sents.zh: 所以他们没有进去，走了。
sents.en: So they did not go in, and left.

sents.zh: 他一直为国家做事，做到很老。
sents.en: He served his state until he was very old.

sents.zh: 到了今天，他的故事还有很多人在说。
sents.en: To this day many people still tell his story.
